verdict.rationale: PostHog's API docs say OAuth can grant scoped access without sharing a personal API key, so it has its own first-party mechanism for limited-privilege credentials. The evidence does not tie this to agents, and the CLI flow stores a full personal API token, so least-privilege setup for an agent is not clearly documented. missing for 10: documented scope list or granularity for API keys/tokens, explicit agent- or MCP-specific scoped credential issuance, project-level or read-only restriction details, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can issue scoped/least-privilege API credentials for an agent

citations.quote: OAuth lets users grant your app scoped access without sharing their personal API key.
